title: A core gets the same number and description history entries
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CORERN-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL CORERN PART), is tracked at {Location-A} with a Core Charge (for example $25.00), so it has a core, {Core-A}, described "Core for {Description-A}".
  • The new part number is {Number-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CORERN-01B) and the new description is {Description-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL CORERN NEW).
custom_steps:
1. Open {Part-A}, change Part Number to {Number-A} and Description to {Description-B}, and click Save.
  2. Search "Core for {Description-B}".
  3. If the core has a row of its own, open its Part History.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: It saves.
  • Step 2: Write down whether the core has a row of its own. If it has none, its Part History cannot be opened by hand: write 'not checked by hand' in the result comment and stop.
  • Step 3: The core has "Part number updated | Original number: {Part-A} | New number: {Number-A}" and "Description updated | Original description: Core for {Description-A} | New description: Core for {Description-B}".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S10-R26, S13-R15, S13-R18, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows a core. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R26: “When the part has a core, the core gets the same number or description entry. The core's description entries read its own description, "Core for {description}".”
  • S13-R15: “A changed description also renames the part's core, which reads "Core for {description}".”
  • S13-R18: “Saving a changed number renames the part in place. The part keeps its identity, its history, and every line that holds it. Its Part Library entry is renamed with it, and its core takes the same number. No new Part Library entry is created.”
